name: sigil
description: Vendor-neutral AI skills, agents, and rules for multiple languages.

plugins.name: essentials
plugins.description: Explain a diff for any audience, in any programming language. With sigil add, also installs the Filesystem MCP, config-file protection, and a command that authors new catalog artifacts. As plugins, add mcp-filesystem, hook-protect-config and hook-reviewer-bash-guard; the authoring command needs sigil add. Dev-tool permissions are per language: each starter pack carries its own.

plugins.name: dotnet-starter
plugins.description: Complete setup for .NET / C# development. Includes the cs-generate-tests skill (plus its C# testing rule and the cs-code-reviewer agent as automatically resolved deps). With sigil add, also installs the Filesystem MCP, config-file protection, and common dev-tool permissions. As plugins, add mcp-filesystem, hook-protect-config and hook-reviewer-bash-guard; the permissions need sigil add.

plugins.name: python-starter
plugins.description: Complete setup for Python development. Includes the py-generate-tests skill (plus its Python testing rule and the py-code-reviewer agent as automatically resolved deps). With sigil add, also installs the Filesystem MCP, config-file protection, and common dev-tool permissions. As plugins, add mcp-filesystem, hook-protect-config and hook-reviewer-bash-guard; the permissions need sigil add.

plugins.name: react-starter
plugins.description: Complete setup for React development. Includes the react-generate-tests skill (plus its React testing rule and the react-code-reviewer agent as automatically resolved deps). With sigil add, also installs the Filesystem MCP, config-file protection, and common dev-tool permissions. As plugins, add mcp-filesystem, hook-protect-config and hook-reviewer-bash-guard; the permissions need sigil add.

plugins.name: dotnet-tooling
plugins.description: Full .NET / C# tooling suite — all imported cs- skills, agents, and rules. Skills include scaffolding, testing, documentation, dependency management, security auditing, release preparation, and package vetting. Skill deps (rules + agents) are auto-resolved by the wizard's deps step.

plugins.name: typescript-starter
plugins.description: Complete setup for TypeScript development. Includes generate-tests, document, and release skills plus their deps. With sigil add, also installs the Filesystem MCP, config-file protection, and common dev-tool permissions. As plugins, add mcp-filesystem, hook-protect-config and hook-reviewer-bash-guard; the permissions need sigil add.

plugins.name: typescript-tooling
plugins.description: Full TypeScript tooling suite — all imported ts- skills, agents, and rules. Skills include testing, scaffolding, documentation, dependency management, security auditing, and release preparation. Skill deps are auto-resolved by the wizard's deps step.

plugins.name: angular-starter
plugins.description: Complete setup for Angular development. Includes generate-tests and generate-component skills plus their deps. With sigil add, also installs the Filesystem MCP, config-file protection, and common dev-tool permissions. As plugins, add mcp-filesystem, hook-protect-config and hook-reviewer-bash-guard; the permissions need sigil add.

plugins.name: angular-tooling
plugins.description: Full Angular tooling suite — all imported ng- skills, agents, and rules. Covers Angular-specific concerns: components, RxJS, Signals, templates, security, and testing patterns for Angular applications. Skill deps are auto-resolved by the wizard's deps step.

plugins.name: python-tooling
plugins.description: Full Python tooling suite — all py- skills, agents, and rules. Skills include scaffolding, testing, documentation, dependency management, security auditing, and release preparation. Skill deps are auto-resolved by the wizard's deps step.

plugins.name: react-tooling
plugins.description: Full React tooling suite — all react- skills, agents, and rules. Skills include scaffolding, testing, documentation, dependency management, security auditing, and release preparation. Skill deps are auto-resolved by the wizard's deps step.

plugins.name: spec-driven
plugins.description: The /feature conductor: drives one feature through clarify, spec, plan, TDD build, review and close-out with explicit approval gates. Requires the agent-skills collection (addyosmani/agent-skills), installed separately. Works with any language.

plugins.name: cli-builder
plugins.description: Design, build, audit, or refactor a command-line interface and the setup wizard layered over it. Includes the cli and wizard skills (with per-stack guidance for Node/TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust and .NET), their CLI and wizard rules, and the two auditor agents as automatically resolved deps. Works with any language.

plugins.name: deepseek-worker
plugins.description: Plan and review in the main session, and hand mechanical coding steps to a headless Claude Code run on the paid DeepSeek API (mk-exec), with its own config dir, effort low, medium or high, and a full log per run. Includes /mk-delegate, /mk-check (which installs mk-exec, workflow-report and the worker config from its references), the orchestration rule as a resolved dep, and the worker-mode guard hook (the plugin depends on hook-worker-mode-guard). Requires Claude Code and a DeepSeek API key. Works with any language.

plugins.name: hook-protect-config
plugins.description: Blocks Edit/Write tool calls that target secret-bearing files (.env and .env.*, .envrc, private keys, certificates, credential and secrets data files). Templates such as .env.example stay editable. As a plugin, this is for Claude Code only.

plugins.name: hook-reviewer-bash-guard
plugins.description: Blocks write-shaped Bash commands (file writes and redirects, in-place edits, git commits and checkouts, package installs, fixers and formatters) when a read-only reviewer or auditor subagent runs them. The main session and every other agent are not affected. As a plugin, this is for Claude Code only.

plugins.name: hook-worker-mode-guard
plugins.description: While worker mode is on (the file ~/.claude/state/worker-mode exists), blocks Edit, Write, MultiEdit and NotebookEdit calls so code changes go through a delegated worker instead of the main session. Plan files and anything under ~/.claude stay editable. Does nothing while worker mode is off. As a plugin, this is for Claude Code only.

plugins.name: mcp-ado
plugins.description: Connects Claude Code (and Copilot) to the Azure DevOps MCP server, enabling structured access to ADO boards, work items, and core APIs. Requires the environment variables ADO_ORG and ADO_MCP_PERSONAL_TOKEN. As a plugin, this is for Claude Code only.

plugins.name: mcp-context-mode
plugins.description: Connects Claude Code (and Copilot) to the local context-mode MCP server, which must be installed globally and available on PATH. As a plugin, this is for Claude Code only.

plugins.name: mcp-filesystem
plugins.description: Connects Claude Code (and Copilot) to the official MCP filesystem server, enabling structured read/write access to local directories via the MCP protocol. As a plugin, this is for Claude Code only.

plugins.name: mcp-maku-jam
plugins.description: Connects Claude Code (and Copilot) to the MakuJam remote MCP server over HTTP at mcp.jam.dev. As a plugin, this is for Claude Code only.
